messages.content: Write the About page for a company that makes scheduling software for medical clinics. Around 250 words.

output:
Here's the About page (247 words):

---

**About Meridian Clinic Scheduling**

Meridian started in 2019, when our founder spent three years running the front desk at a busy pediatric practice. She watched staff juggle phone calls, paper charts, and three different software tools just to book a single follow-up visit. Patients waited on hold. Providers ran double-booked. Nobody had a clean picture of the day until it was already half over.

We built Meridian to fix that, one clinic at a time. The software handles appointment booking, waitlists, recall reminders, and provider calendars in one place, and it syncs with the EHR systems clinics already use so staff don't re-enter the same patient twice. Front-desk teams see open slots across every provider and location at a glance. Patients book online, get a text reminder, and reschedule without calling in.

Today, more than 400 clinics use Meridian to run their front desks, from single-provider family practices to multi-site specialty groups. Our support team includes former practice managers who know what it's like to have a waiting room fill up faster than the schedule can handle it.

We keep the product simple on purpose. A clinic's front desk staff turn over, training time is short, and every minute spent fighting software is a minute not spent with a patient. Meridian is built to get out of the way.

Based in Austin, Texas, our team works directly with clinic staff to shape what we build next.
